title: Eco Points
tagline: EcoPoints is a gamified sustainability rewards platform that incentivizes eco-friendly actions
description:
EcoPoints transforms everyday eco-friendly actions into real, verifiable rewards on the blockchain. By integrating IoT devices, partner apps, and user submissions, EcoPoints captures sustainable behaviors — from taking public transport to recycling plastic bottles — and records them on Zircuit for transparency and proof.
Zircuit’s unique AI-enabled sequencer with built-in security ensures:
Fast & Cheap Transactions: Eco-friendly actions don’t get bottlenecked by high fees or congestion.
Modular Architecture: EcoPoints can tap into external data sources and proof systems (e.g., verifying a transit ride or recycling scan) without compromising speed.
On-Chain Verification: Each action is turned into a verifiable transaction, preventing fraud or false claims.
Scalability: EcoPoints isn’t limited to one city — Zircuit’s infra allows global expansion with localized integrations.
Users earn EcoPoints tokens, redeemable for eco-conscious products, NFTs, or discounts with partner brands. Zircuit enables secure cross-partner reward transfers, meaning points can move seamlessly between apps, brands, and ecosystems.
This creates a global green economy where eco-actions are consistently rewarded, and brands can transparently prove their contribution to sustainability.
